analysis.interpretation_limit: An 8-channel necessity result is still a subspace result and does not establish a motif or biochemical mechanism.
analysis.within_parent_ranking: descending minimum of BRAF and SLC25A48 median necessity loss for shared parents; descending gene median for gene-ranked parents

design.condition: transfer every V-local candidate channel except the named 8-channel child
design.parent_selection_rule: top three positive cross-gene maximin blocks with effect median exceeding neutral in both genes, plus the top block within each gene, deduplicated in that order

follow_up.leading_children: split to individual channels, then test only-group sufficiency and V/upstream/downstream localization

question: Which 8-channel children account for the necessity of the three shared and two top gene-ranked 32-channel parent blocks?
